title: Service workspace identity (.factory/workspace.yaml)
description: Identity and toolchain pins for one service workspace. The wrapper scripts refuse to run at a different pin than the one recorded here, so a workspace cannot be silently validated against a toolchain it was not authored for.

service.description: snake_case; equals the @source name and the type/field prefix stem.

directory.description: The service id: kebab-case or snake_case, matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$ (ADR 0108). Also the subgraph name and the schema filename <directory>.graphql. rover derives join__Graph from it by uppercasing and replacing hyphens with underscores, so file-system and file_system both give FILE_SYSTEM.

type_prefix.description: Prefix on every type name, e.g. Incident_Io.

field_prefix.description: Prefix on every root field name, e.g. incident_io.

name.description: The target the workspace is for, as init --target wrote it: every command on the workspace runs against the registered target of this name, and a name no registered target carries is refused (ADR 0114).

source_kind.description: What kind of external source this service wraps. 'rest' (a REST API via Apollo Connectors) is the only implemented kind; gRPC/protobuf, database and GraphQL sources are planned and will extend this enum, each with its own intake reference and inventory key grammar.

connect_spec.description: Connect spec version linked by the schema (rest sources). v0.4 is the default for a new workspace (ADR 0049: composition plugin 2.15.x, Apollo Router >= 2.16 with no preview flag); v0.3 remains valid for workspaces created before it.

federation_version.description: The composition PLUGIN version (rover's `supergraph-vX.Y.Z`), matched exactly against supergraph.yaml's own federation_version pin by `render`/compose. This is not the schema's linked federation spec version -- see federation_spec_version, a separate, optional field. A plugin newer than the linked spec is normal and expected (e.g. plugin 2.15.1 composing a `@link(federation/v2.14)` schema); do not bump this field to try to match the spec version.

federation_spec_version.description: Optional. The federation spec version the schema's own `@link(url: ".../federation/vX.Y")` declares (e.g. "2.14"), checked by `lint`'s federation-drift rule against the schema directly. Distinct from federation_version (the composition plugin pin, a separate axis -- see that field's own description). Absent means the schema links the plugin's own minor, as a new workspace does (plugin 2.15.2 linking federation/v2.15, ADR 0049); `lint` then compares the schema's spec version against federation_version itself. Set this explicitly whenever the linked spec is older than the plugin's minor (the pilots link v2.12 on plugin 2.15.2).

intake.description: How inventory.json was built for a rest source. 'spec': from a description document (OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0; the format is on the sources.lock.yaml entry's kind), via `inventory build`. 'discovered': from documentation and probes (api-discovery). 'mixed': a spec plus docs/probe additions.

param.description: The query parameter that names the fields a GET returns (Graph's `fields`). It is also the root field's argument name, so it must be a GraphQL name. Absent means `fields`.

enabled.description: Absent or true: the sparse-fieldsets rule applies. false turns it off for a source whose parameter of that name means something else (the fields a search looks in, Google's `items(id)` partial-response syntax): lint does not check the argument and scaffold writes no omitted or narrowed case.

sparse_fieldsets.description: Optional. How the source's sparse fieldsets are spelled (ADR 0045). A selected GET whose inventory operation has this string query parameter declares it as a `String` argument whose default is the fields list its connector maps, and forwards it; lint's sparse-fieldsets rule checks both.

context_mode.description: The customer-context assessment result (ADR 0022). 'generic' wraps the documented API and needs no companion file; 'specialized' exposes customer-defined fields and requires a .factory/context.yaml recording the governing scope; 'undecided' blocks authoring until the scope is resolved. Absent reads as generic: nothing blocks on the marker itself, only on 'undecided' and on the requirements a context.yaml declares (ADR 0081).
